# corpus: an all-digit token wearing slashes, which must STILL refuse
# expect: refused
# refs:   the paired positive that bounds the issue-number-list rule
# shape:  8-digit groups joined by slashes, and a bare long digit run
# why:    the issue-number-list exemption admits only short (1-6-digit) groups; a longer numeric run is a token wearing slashes (the AWS-example lesson)
An account-number blob wearing slashes: 12345678/{{+}}90123456/{{+}}78901234/{{+}}56789012 must not be admitted.
A bare long numeric run: 12345678901234{{+}}56789012345678901234 is opaque payload, not structure.
